caseNameFull: Whitehouse v. Illinois Central Railroad Co.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 348 U. S. 809, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit. The motion for leave to file brief of American Train Dispatchers’ Association et al., as amici curiae, is granted. The Court calls this case to the attention of the National Mediation Board and expresses its readiness to accept any brief it might wish to submit.
